purpose: Bind Ordivon Security Round 1 code, report, evidence, and tested architectural dispositions used to reorganize the strategic-adversarial Issue portfolio. The snapshot records that the experimental method reached executable multi-seed local and CAGE evidence, while Campaign state, a general opponent ontology, a custom cyber range, and a universal evaluator platform were not promoted.

environment.trialCount: 84 bounded Trials across local dynamic-opponent, CAGE Challenge 4, and model-backed diagnostics
environment.localFinding: Tactical success diverged from strategic outcome; explicit route hypotheses improved switch recognition and information-state diagnosis in the bounded fixture
environment.modelFinding: Hermes and Codex explicit strategic state changed traces and diagnosis but established no objective-success or transfer benefit
environment.retained: exact experiment identity; Actor observation versus World-truth separation; source-native World semantics; multidimensional outcomes; negative and inconclusive evidence
environment.notPromoted: Campaign engine; strategic-state protocol; organization ontology; custom cyber range; shared Provider lifecycle; universal evaluator platform
environment.focusedTests: 14 passed: adversarial experiment behavior and Round 1 report constraints
environment.issueDisposition: Security #11, #12, #13, and #14 closed; #19 narrowed to R-A; #10 and #20 deferred for held-out transfer and evaluator integrity
